_comment: A7 fix (2026-08-12 review), extended by B1 (2026-08-12 second review). SHA256 -> {f_min, f_max} manifest for the G2(b) f_min ladder, pre-registered BEFORE any rung's DLL is built. g2b_gate.py refuses to read (ROW 0) any leg -- widened OR baseline -- whose dll_sha256 is not a key here, or whose f_min/f_max here does not match what that leg is claimed to be. Populate one entry per rung (and the baseline entry) as each Developer-session build lands; never edit an existing entry after its leg has been run. The shim integer identifies nothing (it has already collided twice, 20260034/20260035) -- the SHA is the only authority, per standing memory.
_entries_expected: f_min=200 f_max=3000 (BASELINE -- the [200,3000) reference build; required by B1, not previously checked at all)
_baseline_note: No real DLL SHA256 is entered here for the baseline yet -- fabricating one would defeat the check it exists to run. It must be the actual hash of whichever binary is code-identical to the pinned production reference build (main's f2f30c89, per standing memory; NOT p23_common.py's own DLL_SHA256 constant, which standing memory flags as the unmerged rc4-decode-depth three-pass build). Populate this from a real build before the first leg is run through the gate -- until then B1's check fails closed (ROW 0) by construction, which is the intended discipline.
